title: Run a single scraper and watch live progress
description: This verifies that an operator can start one scraper with valid parameters and see live start, log, and completion updates with a final status.

steps.description: Click the control to run a single scraper
Fill in the match identifier field with a valid value
Fill in the team name field with a valid value
Verify live execution logs are displayed
Verify the scraper finishes with a final status and exit code

title: List all scrapers on the dashboard
description: This verifies that the dashboard shows the full set of supported scrapers with their current status so an operator can choose what to run.

steps.description: Verify all supported scrapers are displayed
Verify scraper status information is displayed

title: Run scrapers sequentially in batch mode
description: This verifies that an operator can launch multiple scrapers in sequence and see batch progress updates through completion.

steps.description: Click the control to run scrapers in batch
Verify batch progress events are displayed

title: Create a scheduled scraper job
description: Verify that a user can add a scheduled job for a scraper and see it appear in the schedule list.

steps.description: Add a new schedule for a scraper with a valid cron expression and sandbox parameters
Verify the new scheduled job appears in the schedule list

title: Preview a supported scraper with validation warnings
description: This verifies that a data analyst can open a sandbox preview for a supported scraper and review validation warnings alongside the previewed data.

steps.description: Click the control to open a preview for a supported scraper
Verify validation warnings are displayed when present

title: Create, pause, resume, run now, and delete a schedule
description: This verifies that an operator can manage a scheduled scraper job end to end, including pausing, resuming, running immediately, and deleting it afterward.

steps.description: Click the link to open scheduler management
Create a new schedule for a supported scraper with a valid cron expression
Verify the schedule is removed from the list

title: Run a scheduled job immediately
description: Verify that a user can trigger a scheduled scraper to run now and see execution results returned in the UI.

steps.description: Create a new scheduled job with valid scraper and cron values
Trigger the scheduled job to run immediately
Verify execution results are displayed for the triggered job

title: Export a preview as CSV
description: This verifies that a user can export a supported preview dataset as CSV after selecting the desired preview content.

steps.description: Open a preview for a supported scraper
Select CSV as the export format
Verify a CSV export is generated

title: Export a preview with transforms to Excel
description: This verifies that a data analyst can apply transforms to previewed data and export the transformed result as an Excel file.

steps.description: Open a preview for a supported scraper
Select Excel as the export format
Verify a transformed Excel export is generated

title: Pause and resume a scheduled job
description: Verify that a user can pause a schedule, resume it, and keep it available in the schedule list.

steps.description: Create a new scheduled job with valid scraper and cron values
Pause the newly created scheduled job
Verify the schedule remains available and is shown as active

title: Show a failure when a browser binary is unavailable for an online scraper
description: This verifies that an operator sees live failure logs and an error completion state when a browser-dependent scraper cannot execute.

steps.description: Click the control to run a single scraper
Select an online scraper that requires a browser binary
Verify the scraper ends with an error status and non-zero exit code

title: Review execution history records
description: This verifies that an analyst can open execution history and see past scraper runs with their core run details.

steps.description: Click the link to view execution history
Verify execution history records are displayed
Verify run duration and record count information is displayed

title: Delete a scheduled job
description: Verify that a user can delete an existing scheduled job and remove it from the list.

steps.description: Create a new scheduled job with valid scraper and cron values
Delete the newly created scheduled job
Verify the scheduled job no longer appears in the list

title: Review aggregate execution metrics and per-scraper stats
description: This verifies that an analyst can open the reporting views and inspect aggregated success metrics together with per-scraper statistics.

steps.description: Click the link to view execution history metrics
Verify aggregate execution metrics are displayed

title: Reject a run request for an unknown scraper
description: This verifies that the dashboard does not start execution when an operator tries to run a scraper that is not supported.

steps.description: Click the control to run a single scraper
Fill in the scraper identifier field with an unknown value
Verify a scraper not found message is displayed

title: Run HTML diagnostics for a scraper URL
description: Verify that a user can run a diagnostic check for a scraper URL and see the resulting structural analysis.

steps.description: Select a supported scraper to diagnose
Fill in a valid scraper URL
Verify a diagnostic result is displayed

title: Compare two diagnostic snapshots
description: Verify that a user can compare two stored snapshots and see whether the structure changed.

steps.description: Run two diagnostic checks that create distinct snapshots
Verify a comparison result is displayed

title: Run HTML diagnostics and inspect a snapshot result
description: This verifies that a maintenance user can run an HTML structure check for a scraper URL and see the resulting snapshot details.

steps.description: Click the link to open diagnostics
Verify a diagnostic snapshot result is displayed
Verify HTML structure check details are displayed

title: Reject an unsupported export format
description: This verifies that a user cannot export preview data using a format that is not supported by the app.

steps.description: Open a preview for a supported scraper
Verify an export validation error is displayed

title: Review diagnostic snapshot history
description: Verify that a user can open diagnostic history and see previously stored snapshots for a scraper.

steps.description: Run a diagnostic check for a supported scraper URL
Open the snapshot history for that scraper
Verify previously stored snapshots are displayed

title: See metrics reflect recent failures
description: This verifies that recent failed runs are reflected in the history reporting views with higher error counts and a lower success rate.

steps.description: Click the link to view execution history metrics
Verify success rate information is displayed

title: Reject a schedule without a cron expression
description: Verify that the scheduler prevents creating a job when the cron expression is missing.

steps.description: Start creating a new scheduled job
Leave the cron expression empty and submit the form
Verify a validation error is visible and the schedule is not created

title: Block preview and export for a legacy script scraper
description: This verifies that unsupported legacy script scrapers cannot use the preview workflow and therefore cannot proceed to export from preview.

steps.description: Click the control to open a preview for a legacy script scraper
Verify an unsupported preview message is displayed

title: Reject an invalid history limit
description: This verifies that the history view handles an invalid pagination limit with a visible validation response instead of showing records.

steps.description: Click the link to view execution history
Verify a history validation error is displayed

title: Reject a diagnostic run without a URL
description: Verify that the diagnostic tool prevents running a check when the URL is missing.

steps.description: Leave the URL empty and run the check
Verify a validation error is visible and no result is created

title: Warn when a schedule is missing a cron expression
description: This verifies that the scheduler form prevents creating a job without the required cron expression.

steps.description: Verify a cron expression validation error is displayed

title: Handle an unknown schedule action target
description: Verify that attempting to pause a non-existent schedule does not change the schedule list state.

steps.description: Open a schedule action for an invalid or missing schedule entry
Verify the schedule list remains unchanged

title: Reject an invalid diagnostic snapshot reference
description: This verifies that the diagnostics view shows a clear validation response when a snapshot reference is invalid.

steps.description: Verify a snapshot validation error is displayed
